scope: two loopback Nodes on one Mac, real Pi through pi-acp, owner-driven cross-computer session UX

environment.nodes: mac-a (127.0.0.1:44001) and mac-b (127.0.0.1:44002), paired with fingerprints
environment.agents: pi-a on mac-a and pi-b on mac-b, pi 0.83.0 through pi-acp 0.0.35, own login

results.detail: both sides approved; peers listed with access auto/confirm
A opened mac-b/pi-b; turn completed in ~7 s; A target showed pi-b · mac-b
same session id on B, origin mac-a, pi process cwd /private/tmp/hmesh-pair/proj-b; B panel showed 由 mac-a 打开 and 项目：proj-b
A showed 等待批准; B approved with the shared session id; A then showed 已批准，开始执行 and the answer
B shared a dedicated folder proj-shared; A's project picker listed it; the B-side agent wrote PONG2 into /tmp/hmesh-pair/proj-shared/shared2.txt
after unsharing, A's view of B's shared projects became empty within the 10 s refresh
A's local pi-a called harnessmesh_mesh_send; B created child session with origin kind agent and chain to A's session; B's agent replied B-VIA-MESH and A returned it
A session became idle and the turn was marked interrupted; the conversation note used the raw English connection error and stayed after reconnection (fixed)
A session closed with 配对已撤销，会话关闭; the note showed the raw transport error (now mapped)

fixes: connection failures in the conversation are shown in Chinese and the note is cleared when polling succeeds again
remaining: the sync indicator can still say 已同步 while a paired computer is unreachable
a remote session waiting for approval shows the state mainly as a header badge; the conversation itself stays empty
tool-level approval (允许一次/拒绝) still needs Claude Code or Codex; Pi never asks
real Tailnet/network failure and discovery/passcode pairing were not tested here (loopback only)
